title: Test external user access
subtitle: Verify sign-in, Contact linking, unique emails and denied access paths.

steps.title: Register and sign in test users
steps.evidence: Test registration, repeat sign-in and account linking in a dev environment with three identities

steps.title: Verify Contact association
steps.evidence: Use the contact-mapping-with-email setting in Microsoft Entra External ID or an invitation flow, then verify the Contact ID after sign-in.

steps.title: Check unique emails and no duplicates
steps.evidence: Power Pages requires unique Contact email addresses, and duplicates, even on inactive records, can prevent authentication.

steps.title: Test scoped and denied access
steps.evidence: Sign in as both test customers and as an anonymous visitor, then confirm table permissions with Contact scope deny the other customer's records.
